layout.text: Why it costs what it costs

items: **The dose.** Every can carries 12 grams of ketones. A lot of what else is on the shelf sits around 2. Dose is what drives the effect, not the format, and dosing properly is most of the cost.
**The molecule.** Bioidentical D-BHB, the same ketone your body makes when you fast or sleep, rather than a synthetic stand-in.
**The testing.** Informed Sport Certified, every single batch, so an athlete at any level can drink it without wondering.
**The number.** The variety pack is six cans at $29.94, so $4.99 a can. Say it plainly if you are doing the math on camera, and use your own real comparison next to it.
**The line that lands.** You are not selling a drink that is more expensive than the others. You are selling the only one dosed high enough to be worth drinking, and you can say that plainly.

layout.label: Know this before you use the hooks below
layout.text: Every reframe on this tab works because the price is defensible, not because it is being explained away. **Never apologise for it and never discount your way past it.** Deal-led content is the worst performing thing we make.
How to run them — do’s & don’ts

items: **DO say “brain fuel” at least once — non-negotiable.**It's the whole point. Every video names the category out loud.

**Keep it personal and specific.**'It replaced my $6 coffee' beats 'it's good value.' Real numbers and a real routine sell it.
**Keep the video about the value, not the deal.**If there's a live offer running, point to it as a quick closing CTA at the very end, never as the hook.

**Give us three phrasings of one hook, not three different hooks.**Three openings on three different hooks tells us which hook works. Three ways of saying the same one tells us which words work. Both are useful and we have barely tested the second.

layout.text: We are putting brain fuel on the map on TikTok Shop. Kenetik is a brand-new category, and creators are how we get there. We win by finding the opening lines that turn a scroll into a sale. The first 1 to 3 seconds decide whether someone keeps watching and taps to buy, so your job is simple: test these hooks and help us find what converts.

pos.heading: What Kenetik is
pos.text: Metabolic brain fuel: clean, caffeine-free focus in a can or a shot. Steady, calm clarity that lasts, without the crash. 12g of ketones, caffeine-free, sugar-free, nothing artificial. Always lead with the person's problem or the moment they feel it, then bring in Kenetik as the fix.

neg.heading: What Kenetik is NOT
neg.text: Not an energy drink, a pre-workout, or a supplement. It is a category of its own, so don't label it as any of those. The hard rule: no medical claims. It does not cure, treat, or fix anything, and it is never offered as the answer to anxiety, ADHD, focus disorders, brain injury, concussions, or disease. **Describing what caffeine did to you is a different thing and it is fine**: jittery, wired, anxious, could not sleep. Say that as your reason for switching. Just never put Kenetik on the other side of it as the fix.

layout.text: Five Kenetik videos still selling right now, some of them posted months ago. Different people, different techniques, and every quote below is the line they actually opened with out loud. The figure is what that video sold on TikTok Shop over the last 90 days. Tap any to watch.

“Not six, not twelve. You get 24.”

layout.label: What they have in common
layout.text: Not a niche and not a look. One repeats what other people are already calling it, one tells you plainly what you get, one reports a switch already made, one names the problem before anything else, and one is just a time of day. **Every one of them opens on a person or a situation, and not one opens on ketones.** The real common trait is that each one sounds like the person who filmed it rather than an ad read. You do not need a studio or a script. You need a real first line, in your own words.

layout.heading: The bottom line
paragraphs: Every audience feels the same thing in their own way: the **2pm crash and brain fog** that kills a workday, the **wired-but-tired** slump from too much coffee, or the **mind that quits before the body does** under pressure. Kenetik answers all three as clean, caffeine-free brain fuel, 12g of ketones that give the brain steady energy for **calm, clear focus without the crash**.

So pick your lane, open every video with a hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds, name the problem your people feel, and let Kenetik land as the answer. Post a few, see what sticks, and we amplify the winners. Every hook you test teaches us what converts on TikTok Shop, and that is how we put brain fuel on the map together.

layout.text: Why Kenetik costs what it costs

Someone in your comments will ask about the price. **Don’t apologise for it and don’t discount your way past it**, because deal-led content is the worst performing thing we make. Know why it costs what it costs and you can answer it in one line.

items: **The dose.** Every can carries 12 grams of ketones. A lot of what else is on the shelf sits around 2. Dose is what drives the effect, not the format, and dosing properly is most of the cost.
**The molecule.** Bioidentical D-BHB, the same ketone your body makes when you fast or sleep, rather than a synthetic stand-in.
**The testing.** Informed Sport Certified, every single batch, so an athlete at any level can drink it without wondering.

**What that buys you on camera.** You are not selling a drink that is more expensive than the others. You are selling the only one dosed high enough to be worth drinking, and you can say that plainly.

The console's deliberate write lane (kind hook_swap) is the only writer that moves a placement: it applies one approved swap, appends the receipt to decisions and stamps hooks[].entered.
_doc._a_proposal_is_never_an_edit: A line the turn proposes is added to hooks{} with no placement and named in changes_pending; the gate accepts an unplaced line, because a proposed, a declined and a displaced line are all legitimately on no tab, and it refuses a placement that points at no line.
